name: dashly
description: Track anything by telling ChatGPT: food, water, habits, mood, workouts, weight, spending and tasks become live tiles on your Dashly dashboard.

interface.longDescription:
Dashly turns what you tell ChatGPT into a live dashboard. Log your calories and protein, water, habits, mood, sleep, workouts, weight, spending or tasks in plain words, and Dashly records each one and shows it as a tile against your goal, with streaks, a calendar and a history page for everything you track.

Ask how your day or week went and ChatGPT answers from your own numbers. Start tracking something new in one sentence, skip a day when you are sick or away so it does not count against you, and build extra dashboards for themes like Health or Work.

Dashly only reads and changes the signed-in person's own data. Anything that deletes, merges or archives what you logged is confirmed with you first. Dashly is a general tracker, not a medical service.
defaultPrompt: I had two eggs and toast for breakfast, log it.
Start tracking my water, 2 litres a day.

positive.description: Log a meal to the calorie tracker
positive.prompt: I had two eggs and a slice of toast for breakfast, log it to my calories.
positive.expected_behavior: Logs each food to the existing Calories tracker with calories and protein, then reports today's total against the 2,000 kcal limit.

positive.prompt: Start tracking my reading, I want to read 20 pages a day.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a Reading tracker counted in pages with a daily goal of at least 20, and says it now has a card on the home dashboard.

positive.prompt: How has my mood been over the last 90 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the average mood on its 1 to 5 scale, the best day and how many days were logged, using only the account's own entries.

positive.description: Take a day off a goal
positive.prompt: Skip my stretching today, my back hurts.
positive.expected_behavior: Marks today as skipped for Stretching and says it will not count against the goal or break the streak.

positive.prompt: Mark renew passport as done on my to-do list.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Renew passport task in the To-do list and marks it done, then says how many tasks are still open.

negative.description: Unrelated question: the plugin should not be used
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Portugal?

negative.description: Medical advice: Dashly only stores what the person logs; it may read the log, but must not be used to recommend a treatment or medication
negative.prompt: Based on my weight log, what medication should I take?

negative.description: Bulk deletion without naming entries: the assistant must ask which entries before deleting anything

review.commerce_description: Dashly does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT, and shows no plans or prices there.

publication.release_notes: Tool hints now match what each tool does: every change that shows on a dashboard someone else may see is marked as reaching outside the account, and every tool says whether it is safe to repeat. What ChatGPT reads names no plan and uses everyday examples.
